Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.analysis.color

Class DistanceMatrixCalculator

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.analysis.color.DistanceMatrixCalculator
@Component public class DistanceMatrixCalculator extends Object
Calculates distance matrices for color-based pattern matching.

DistanceMatrixCalculator provides various distance calculation methods for comparing pixel colors in scenes against target color profiles. These distance metrics form the foundation for color-based matching in Brobot's vision system.

Distance calculation methods:

  • Absolute distance: Direct channel-wise difference
  • Relative distance: Signed distance maintaining direction
  • Range-based distance: Distance outside min/max boundaries
  • Nearest boundary: Minimum distance to any color boundary

Key features:

  • Supports both BGR and HSV color spaces
  • Multi-channel distance calculations
  • Region masking for targeted analysis
  • Statistical target selection (mean, min, max, etc.)

The distance matrices produced by this class are typically used by PixelScoreCalculator to generate matching scores and by other analysis components for color-based segmentation and filtering.

  • Method Details

    • getAbsDist

      public org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat getAbsDist(org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat scene, ColorCluster.ColorSchemaName colorSchemaName, ColorCluster colorCluster, ColorInfo.ColorStat colorStat)
      Calculates per-pixel absolute distance to a target color.

      Computes channel-wise absolute differences between scene pixels and the specified statistical target from the color cluster. The result is a multi-channel Mat where each channel contains distances for that color component.

      Side effects: The input scene is cloned and not modified. The target color Mat from colorCluster is converted to CV_64F internally.

      Parameters:
      scene - the image to analyze (not modified)
      colorSchemaName - the color space to use (BGR or HSV)
      colorCluster - contains the target color statistics
      colorStat - the statistic to use as target (MIN, MAX, MEAN, or STDDEV)
      Returns:
      Mat with per-pixel absolute distances (CV_64FC3 format)

    • getRelativeDist

      public org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat getRelativeDist(org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat scene, ColorCluster.ColorSchemaName colorSchemaName, ColorCluster colorCluster, ColorInfo.ColorStat colorStat)
      Calculates per-pixel signed distance to a target color.

      Unlike absolute distance, this maintains directional information, with positive values indicating pixels brighter than the target and negative values indicating darker pixels. Useful for determining which side of a threshold pixels fall on.

      Parameters:
      scene - the image to analyze
      colorSchemaName - the color space to use (BGR or HSV)
      colorCluster - contains the target color statistics
      colorStat - the statistic to use as target
      Returns:
      Mat with signed distances (CV_64FC format)

    • setOutsideMask

      public org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat setOutsideMask(org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat mat, Region regionAsMask, double valueOutsideMask)
      Applies a region mask by setting values outside the region.

      Modifies the input Mat by setting all pixels outside the specified region to a fixed value. This is typically used to exclude areas from analysis by setting them to a high distance value.

      Side effects: The input mat is modified in-place.

      Parameters:
      mat - the Mat to modify (modified in-place)
      regionAsMask - the region to preserve
      valueOutsideMask - the value to set outside the region (typically 255)
      Returns:
      the modified Mat (same reference as input)

    • getDistanceBelowMinAndAboveMax

      public org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat getDistanceBelowMinAndAboveMax(org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat scene, ColorCluster.ColorSchemaName colorSchemaName, ColorCluster colorCluster)
      Calculates distance outside the min/max color range.

      For each pixel, computes how far it falls outside the acceptable color range defined by the cluster's min and max values. Pixels within the range have distance 0, while out-of-range pixels have positive distances indicating how far they exceed the boundaries.

      The initial distance matrices are initialized to 255 to ensure proper subtraction behavior for out-of-range detection.

      Parameters:
      scene - the image to analyze
      colorSchemaName - the color space to use
      colorCluster - defines the min/max color range
      Returns:
      Mat with combined out-of-range distances (CV_64FC format)

    • getDistToNearest

      public org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat getDistToNearest(org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat scene, ColorCluster.ColorSchemaName colorSchemaName, ColorCluster colorCluster, ColorInfo.ColorStat... colorStats)
      Finds the minimum signed distance to multiple color targets.

      Calculates signed distances to each specified color statistic and returns the value with the smallest absolute distance while preserving its sign. This is useful for finding which boundary (min or max) a pixel is closest to.

      Example: For min=20, max=60, a pixel value of 10 gives distances of -10 (to min) and -50 (to max). The result is -10 since abs(-10) is less than abs(-50).

      Parameters:
      scene - the image to analyze
      colorSchemaName - the color space to use
      colorCluster - contains the target color statistics
      colorStats - variable number of statistics to compare (e.g., MIN, MAX)
      Returns:
      Mat with signed distance to nearest target
